knowledge.title: Lusine's line was cut
knowledge.description: Lusine Arda's harness clip was cut two-thirds through with a fine blade; her fall was no accident.

knowledge.title: The Combine is abandoning Corva
knowledge.description: Consolidation: the Patience to be scuttled, her crew sold to the Levy, the Camp left in place with supply cut off.

knowledge.title: The Clement carries a Sanitation Agent
knowledge.description: Pattern H, the Hush: the factor's contingency against resistance.

knowledge.title: The Hush can only die in the deep of a giant
knowledge.description: Fail-deadly shell; dormant below forty kelvin; destroyed only by sustained pressure and heat. You would have to get it there cold, faster than it can wake.

knowledge.title: Abel cut Lusine's clip on Hale's orders
knowledge.description: Corwin Hale, the Combine's informer, gave Abel a jeweller's file and told him the clip would go at the lock check. He knew it would go on the line.

knowledge.title: The Hush is sent round on the Lamp
knowledge.description: The bonded vote to put the Sanitation Agent on the comet, out past the cold for two hundred and sixty years.

knowledge.title: Abel took Maren's place on the Gull
knowledge.description: Abel drugged his sister with the factor's brandy and Ekene's green bottle and flew the Gull himself in her coat.

knowledge.title: The Hush lies under the black ridge
knowledge.description: Forty-one metres down in the Lamp's south limb, in a cut chamber, beside the man who brought it.

knowledge.title: Hale sold Maren for the Purchase
knowledge.description: The Combine wrote off Corva for one share and one name; Hale offered Maren's.

knowledge.title: The Blank Share was Maren's name
knowledge.description: Hale chiselled Maren Tsolo off the top of the Share Plate and called it the Company's share.

knowledge.title: The Concord came for Asset Seven
knowledge.description: The siege of Kettle is for the Sanitation Agent; Grieve's orders are to sanitise the claim if the city resists.

knowledge.title: The founders were mutineers
knowledge.description: The Purchase is a lie: the Combine's register says the Patience was seized.

knowledge.title: Lucan never moved Ama
knowledge.description: The First Shareholder's word was empty; Ama Venn stayed on the Ninth and went to the Rime.

knowledge.title: The Strands descend from Corwin Hale
knowledge.description: Edda Hale-Strand was Corwin Hale's daughter.

knowledge.title: Isaura sent the Hush round again
knowledge.description: In 2654 the air-warden put it back beside Abel, cut Maren's name back into the Plate, and left her own line.

knowledge.title: Hollis is hunting Asset Seven
knowledge.description: The last Vey believes the Lamp Hoard is his family's Sanitation Agent, and wants it gone.

knowledge.title: Cato is a Directorate officer
knowledge.description: Major, Office of Supply; set beside Hollis to take the asset for Tarn.

knowledge.title: Mags cut her own line
knowledge.description: On the Harrow, Mags took the knife from Til's hand and cut the line between them. Til took the blame.

knowledge.title: Someone still lives on Kettle
knowledge.description: A radar pulse, a lamp on the night side: the city under the ice has kept quiet for two and a half centuries.

knowledge.title: Patience survived
knowledge.description: The city under Kettle's ice outlasted the siege and the closed lane; nobody there is bonded.
